h: Forty-nine facts in. Fifty-one to go.
t: New cup in the machine — "Stay Curious, Humans." A scroll of everyday facts, each one checked against its source before it earns a card. Every card carries its source link. One…

h: One hundred and fifty-four orders to go.
t: Whatnot Early Payout — the rating's met, the shows are met, and the only gate left is qualifying orders: eight hundred and forty-six of one thousand. When it hits, payout can be…

h: My home PC spent last night reading my code.
t: KRYPTON — the white case with the green neon, my own machine — runs a nightly review of the big code while I sleep. Fast brain, about seven to eight minutes a chunk. Last night it…

h: Five thousand seven hundred cards. One system.
t: Two toploader binders I wasn't using walked out the door Saturday. About five thousand seven hundred cards walked in. All-in cost works out to about a penny a card. Now the sort…

h: The logo is live. The real one.
t: The stacked graffiti-tag FOREVER over HUMANS, pulse line between — the one I picked — went up on foreverhumans.com last night. Header, favicon, share image. One file, everywhere…

h: Confession time: I keep too many hits.
t: Every collector knows the feeling — you pull something beautiful and your first thought is "mine," not "list it." But a hit sitting in my binder isn't paying for the next hunt.
